value.rationale: The physically natural inverse problem asks which time since the last reset produces a rare joint position, a question inaccessible to ordinary variance/moment summaries. The theorem gives an exhaustive structural phase classification, two critical boundaries, exact local age laws, and a strict interior-optimal witness whose joint ray decay is slower than either endpoint Gaussian while its projected marginal remains endpoint-dominated.
